input: Create a weekly meal budget spreadsheet

gold.taskTitle: Build a Weekly Meal Budget Spreadsheet
gold.taskDescription: Create a spreadsheet to plan and track weekly meal spending within a set budget.

questions.title: What is your total weekly meal budget amount?
questions.description: Understand the specific dollar amount the user wants to stay within each week.

questions.title: Which spreadsheet tool do you want to use?
questions.description: Identify the platform: Excel, Google Sheets, Apple Numbers, or another tool.

questions.title: How many people are you budgeting meals for?
questions.description: Determine whether this is for one person, a couple, a family, etc.

questions.title: Which meals should the spreadsheet cover each day?
questions.description: Clarify whether to track breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, or all of them.

questions.title: Should it track planned costs, actual spending, or both?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants to plan ahead, log real purchases, or do both.

questions.title: Do you want to include grocery shopping lists in the sheet?
questions.description: Find out if the spreadsheet should link meal plans to a corresponding shopping list.

questions.title: Should the spreadsheet roll over or reset each week?
questions.description: Clarify whether unused budget carries forward or the sheet resets to zero every Monday.
